name: Stop Hangs Up Calls
description: Say "stop" during an intercom call to hang it up. While a call is placed, live or announcing, it has the kiosk listen for the stop word, and hangs up when it hears it. Needs Stop word interruption on (Voice Satellite > Wake Word) and remote admin on, with this kiosk's admin password below.
author: Joseph Yancey

settings.title: Remote admin password
settings.description: This kiosk's remote admin password. The plugin uses it to ask the kiosk itself to listen for "stop" and to hang up.
